explication: Evolution Go is a Go-based WhatsApp API. Its principal workflow is an API client request entering authenticated HTTP routes, reaching a domain handler and service, and then operating through a WhatsApp instance; responses return through the API. The repository also documents real-time event transports, media storage, optional message persistence, and license activation. The map uses indexed imports and documented capabilities where source excerpts do not expose wiring; dashed links mark relationships that are documented but not verified in the sampled code.
